Johnson & Johnson's net cash from operating activities rose about 90.9% from fiscal Q1 2024 to fiscal Q4 2024. The filings give no standalone Q4 figure, so I derived it by subtracting nine-month cash flow from the full-year figure.

- **Q4 2024 operating cash flow:** FY2024 was $24,266 million and the nine months ended September 29, 2024 were $17,283 million, so Q4 2024 was $24,266 − $17,283 = $6,983 million.
- **Q1 2024 operating cash flow:** $3,657 million.
- **Change:** ($6,983 − $3,657) / $3,657 = $3,326 / $3,657 ≈ 90.9%.
